# Phase 30 — Implement One Approved Slice

Implement only the explicitly approved slice ID. Before editing inspect git status, latest commit, files and tests. Confirm requirements, ACs, design, contracts and test cases are approved. Implement the smallest coherent vertical slice. Add/adjust tests mapped to ACs. Do not implement adjacent slices, redesign approved UX or change contracts. Run targeted tests after each meaningful change. Stop on a material ambiguity or failing critical test. Report exact diff and commands. Do not approve your own work.
